name: Bonez
detailed_description:
Dive into the most bone-rattling card game in town! Outwit opponents, play Power Cards wisely, and race to reach 21 without busting. Spice things up with strategic bets and win three rounds to become the ultimate Bonez champion! Every draw counts so shuffle the deck, place your bets, and join the Bonez revolution now!

Key Features:


  • No playthrough is ever the same: You’ll never play the same game twice!
  • Free to play
  • Two Currencies, Twice the Fun: Bonez can be played with Chipz; or Bonez - the social currency you get from friends.
  • PvP Betting: Engage in thrilling Bonez and Chipz betting for high-stakes competition.
  • Strategic Card Play: Strategically play House and Power Cards to outscore your opponents and climb the leaderboards.
  • Customizable Power Deck: Craft your winning strategy by building up your Power Deck. Amp up your game by upgrading to Power Boost Cards with special abilities.
  • Friendship Bonuses: Team up with friends who can gift you Bonez every day.
  • Gameplay Emojis: Flaunt your style and taunt your opponents with a fun collection of in-game emojis.
  • Progressive Pots and Rewards: Contribute to the game treasury for exciting bonuses, progressive pots, and rewards.
  • Spectator Mode with Emoji Reactions: Watch and react to your friends’ Bonez games in real-time with the ability to spectate matches. Express your excitement with emojis, adding an interactive twist to the spectator experience!

short_description: Embark on a spectral quest where the clattering of bones reveals a legendary card game. This is not just a gamble; it's a quest to seek victory through strategic wits without succumbing to the haunting specters of defeat. Join the bone-rattling duel of fate & strategy & take your place at the top.
